title: Chrome District
summary: A small crew of fixers in a rain-soaked neon district, squeezed between a street gang and a corporation. Test world for generated sites (task 4-4).
toneNote: Wet neon, cheap tech, everyone owes someone. Street-level cyberpunk: no chrome gods, just people getting by.
setting: The Chrome District is twelve blocks of rain, noodle stalls and repair shops wedged between the old docks and Kessler Corporation's towers. The Chrome Saints run the streets and the chop shops; Kessler runs everything else. Your crew works out of a safehouse above a closed laundromat, taking jobs that nobody with a badge would touch.
rules: Near-future tech: cyberware is common but crude, the net is everywhere and mostly ads. No AI overlords, no magic.
Guns are loud and the Saints answer noise fast. Getting caught on a job means a beating or worse.
Kessler security is slow to arrive but thorough when it does.

world.heat: low: nobody is looking for the crew

factions.name: The Chrome Saints
factions.desc: A street gang that runs the chop shops and protection rackets on the docks side.

factions.name: Kessler Corporation
factions.desc: The corporation that owns the towers, the power grid and most of the police.

regions.name: The Strip
regions.lore: Bars, noodle stalls, clinics and repair shops under a canopy of signs. Neutral ground, mostly.

regions.name: The Docks
regions.lore: Warehouses, container stacks and the Saints' chop shops, where stolen cars and cyberware are stripped for parts.

regions.name: Uptown
regions.lore: Kessler's towers and the clean streets around them. Cameras everywhere; security answers in minutes.

regional: the Saints shake down a shop on the Strip

facts: Vex runs the Saints' chop shop on the docks and keeps the books himself.
